main.description: Requests to see a project's press kits, and the decisions and grants that answer them. Owned by the Local Network root account, one space per project, keyed by the project record's key. Anyone signed in can write a request into it, and only the root writes decisions and grants; only its members (the project's current managers) can read it, so the people asking, and those granted access, never see each other's requests or grants.
main.title: Local Network press kit requests
